title: Universum 1.2
excerpt: An interactive light sculpture: an abstract planet that answers to how visitors move through the room.
description:
Universum 1.2 was made with Skander Jaïbi for Museum van Geluid. I built the 3D sculpture and the video mapping, Skander made the interactive soundscape.
> The installation is an abstract planet, and by moving through the physical space visitors can influence how that planet and its surroundings behave.
> It creates an immersive space that connects two worlds, the digital abstract one and the physical analogue one we live in. Putting them together makes a new micro universe in which the two become one.
> For us the work is part of an ongoing research into making the digital physically tangible, with the aim of creating a digital reality that can be shared with everyone.
credits: Jaco Schilp: 3D sculpture and video mapping. Skander Jaïbi: interactive soundscape. Presented at Museum van Geluid, 2018.
